card.name: Shapeshifter descriptions in Star Trek text
card.fires_on: Small linking words and punctuation inside Star Trek wiki passages about shapeshifting lifeforms, such as 'alter their form' or 'assume a different shape'. It fires on the word just before the new form or appearance is named.
